messages:
Priya: Quick sync: after the RFC we still have an open risk around lookup storming when many sidecars emit traces without billing_key. Need a concrete throttling/invalidation plan.
Ethan: Yep. Two problems: 1) thundering cache lookups for cold traces, 2) stale keyed results when keys rotate.
Luis: For rotations we can version keys and attach key_version to envelope.meta so downstream can detect staleness. But that doesn't solve the lookup blast.
Priya: Idea: pre-warm a probabilistic bloom filter per region that signals which trace_ids are likely to have billing keys. Sidecars can consult it (cheap) and skip lookups when negative.
Ethan: Interesting. Bloom false positives are fine (extra lookups), false negatives would avoid lookups (good). Need to bound bloom size and update cadence.
Luis: Update cadence: build filter every minute from recent key index. Also maintain a tiny LRU on sidecars for recent positive hits (client-side cache).
Priya: Rate-limiting at ingest boundary too: token-bucket per project with burst allowance. If lookup rate > threshold, fallback to marking as 'lookup_deferred' and emit metric.
Ethan: So new billing_status values: final, provisional, lookup_deferred, unattributed. And envelope.meta.lookup_strategy = one of ["direct","bloom","deferred"].
QA: Suggest we also record envelope.meta.key_version and envelope.meta.filter_generation_ts for debugging.
Luis: For key rotations: when a rotation occurs, we publish a key_rotate event. Ingesters listening to key_rotate can invalidate local LRU and request the next bloom on the next cycle.
Priya: Circuit-breaker behavior: if cache backend error rate > 5% for 30s, switch to "deferred" mode for that region and route alerts. ops-bot can annotate the region in observability dashboard.
ops-bot: alert: cache-backend-high-error-rate region=us-east1 rate=6.4% window=35s
Ethan: Metrics to add: bloom_false_positive_rate, sidecar_lru_hit_rate, lookup_throttle_count, deferred_ratio_by_project, key_rotate_events_processed, cache_error_rate. Also expose a "lookup_pending_count" gauge so stitcher can reason about backlog.
Luis: Stitching changes: billing_patch topic still used, but include filter_generation_ts so stitcher can correlate with bloom window and decide match heuristics.
Priya: Operational playbook excerpt: if deferred_ratio_by_project > 0.1 for > 10m, enable short-term bypass (force direct lookup) for that project to avoid revenue leakage, but notify oncall. Long-term fix required.
Ethan: Implementation tasks: 1) bloom-service: compute and publish filter blobs + generation timestamps. 2) sidecar-sdk: bloom check + small LRU + sidecar config flag to opt into bloom. 3) ingester: rate-limit tokens and deferred handling + meta fields. 4) stitcher: accept enhanced billing_patch with filter_generation_ts.
Luis: I'll sketch bloom-service proto and publish interval. Priya: I'll draft the playbook and add runbooks for key rotation. Ethan: I'll add metrics and the circuit-breaker switch in the cache client.
QA: Can we add a small e2e test that simulates key rotation and burst loads?
Priya: Yes, add a synthetic harness job that replays bursts and validates deferred_ratio and patch backlog.
Ethan: Decision summary: adopt bloom pre-check + client LRU to reduce lookups, add ingest-level rate-limits with deferred fallback, extend envelope.meta with lookup_strategy, key_version, filter_generation_ts, and new billing_status enum including 'lookup_deferred'. Use billing_patch stream for corrections. Circuit-breaker for cache errors. Operational playbook for bypass.
ops-bot: deploybot: feature branch for bloom-service and sidecar changes pushed to CI.
Priya: Great. I'll open the schema PR for the meta fields and include tests. We'll reconvene after the bloom prototype has metrics. Thanks.
